introduction.en: National Income accounting provides a comprehensive framework to measure the economic performance of a nation. It serves as a vital tool for policymakers to assess growth and development.
introduction.hi: National Income accounting provides a comprehensive framework to measure the economic performance of a nation. It serves as a vital tool for policymakers to assess growth and development.

body.en: The three methods—Product, Income, and Expenditure—provide a multi-dimensional view of the economy. In India, the NSO uses these to track sectoral contributions. Challenges include the large informal sector and data gaps.
body.hi: The three methods—Product, Income, and Expenditure—provide a multi-dimensional view of the economy. In India, the NSO uses these to track sectoral contributions. Challenges include the large informal sector and data gaps.

conclusion.en: Accurate national income estimation is essential for evidence-based policy formulation and achieving sustainable economic growth.
conclusion.hi: Accurate national income estimation is essential for evidence-based policy formulation and achieving sustainable economic growth.
